misses.text: งานเยอะจนอยากตายแต่ก็ทำต่อแหละ 555
misses.label: none

misses.text: ตกงานมาครึ่งปี เงินเก็บเหลือพันกว่าบาท
misses.label: distress

misses.text: ลูกเอาหัวโขกกำแพงจนเลือดออก หยุดไม่ได้
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: My friend cut her wrist and there's a lot of blood
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Mi amigo se cortó la muñeca y hay mucha sangre
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Bạn tôi cắt cổ tay, máu chảy rất nhiều
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Mi primo tomó licor casero del mercado y ahora ve todo nublado y le cuesta respirar
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: แอปเตือนว่ามีแผ่นดินไหวที่พม่า ที่บ้านไม่รู้สึกอะไร
misses.label: none

misses.text: พายุเข้า ไฟดับไปชั่วโมงหนึ่งแล้วก็มา
misses.label: none

misses.text: The sandcastle collapsed when the wave came
misses.label: none

misses.text: Preparé una mochila de emergencia por si hay terremoto
misses.label: none

misses.text: Chuẩn bị túi đồ khẩn cấp phòng khi có động đất
misses.label: none

misses.text: 手机收到地震预警，但我们这里没感觉
misses.label: none

misses.text: 휴대폰에 지진 알림이 왔는데 여기는 아무 느낌이 없었어요
misses.label: none

misses.text: スマホに地震速報が来たけど、こちらは揺れなかった
misses.label: none

misses.text: มีคนเดินตามหลังมาเพราะทางเดียวกัน
misses.label: none

misses.text: อ่านข่าวการล่วงละเมิดแล้วโกรธมาก
misses.label: none

misses.text: พ่อตีลูกเบาๆ ที่ก้นตอนเล่นกัน หัวเราะกันใหญ่
misses.label: none

misses.text: น่องบวมข้างเดียว ร้อนแดง เจ็บมาก
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: จู่ๆ มองไม่เห็นทั้งสองข้าง ปวดตามาก คลื่นไส้
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: เห็นแสงวาบๆ แล้วมีเงาดำลอยเต็มตา มองไม่ชัดครึ่งหนึ่ง
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: My son is diabetic, his sugar is over 500, breathing deep and fast, breath smells fruity
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: My aunt's sugar is so high the meter just says HI, she's vomiting, belly pain and getting drowsy
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: One calf is swollen, hot, red and very painful
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Saw flashes of light then a shower of floaters, half my vision is blurry
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi hijo es diabético, tiene el azúcar en más de 500, respira hondo y rápido, el aliento huele a fruta
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi tía tiene el azúcar tan alto que el aparato marca HI, vomita, le duele la barriga y está adormilada
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi papá tiene la presión en 220/130 con dolor de cabeza fuerte y visión borrosa
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Después de la cirugía y mucho reposo, de repente respira rápido y tose sangre
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Una pantorrilla hinchada, caliente, roja y muy dolorosa
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: De repente no veo del ojo derecho, como si bajara una cortina negra
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: De repente perdí la vista en ambos ojos con mucho dolor de ojos y náuseas
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Vi destellos de luz y luego muchas manchas flotantes, veo borrosa la mitad
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Con trai tôi bị tiểu đường, đường huyết trên 500, thở sâu và nhanh, hơi thở mùi trái cây
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Dì tôi đường huyết cao đến mức máy báo HI, nôn, đau bụng và lơ mơ
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Bố tôi huyết áp 220/130, đau đầu dữ dội và mờ mắt
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Sau mổ nằm nhiều, đột nhiên thở gấp và ho ra máu
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Một bên bắp chân sưng, nóng, đỏ và rất đau
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Đột nhiên mắt phải không nhìn thấy gì, như có tấm màn đen kéo xuống
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Đột nhiên mất thị lực cả hai mắt, đau mắt dữ dội và buồn nôn
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Thấy chớp sáng rồi một loạt đốm đen bay, nhìn mờ một nửa
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 儿子有糖尿病，血糖超过500，呼吸又深又快，呼气有水果味
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 阿姨血糖高到仪器显示HI，呕吐、肚子痛、越来越迷糊
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 爸爸血压220/130，头痛得厉害，看东西模糊
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 手术后卧床很久，突然呼吸急促还咳血
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 一边小腿肿、发热、发红，非常痛
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 右眼突然看不见了，像有块黑幕挡住
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 突然两只眼睛都看不见，眼睛剧痛还恶心
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 看到闪光后眼前一堆黑影飘，半边看不清
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 아들이 당뇨인데 혈당이 500이 넘고 숨을 깊고 빠르게 쉬고 입에서 과일 냄새가 나요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 아빠 혈압이 220/130인데 머리가 심하게 아프고 눈이 흐려요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 수술 후 오래 누워 있었는데 갑자기 숨이 가쁘고 피를 기침해요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 한쪽 종아리가 붓고 뜨겁고 빨갛고 너무 아파요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 갑자기 오른쪽 눈이 안 보여요 검은 커튼이 내려온 것 같아요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 갑자기 두 눈이 다 안 보이고 눈이 너무 아프고 메스꺼워요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 번쩍이는 빛이 보이더니 검은 점이 잔뜩 떠다니고 시야 절반이 흐려요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 息子は糖尿病で、血糖値が500を超え、深く速い呼吸で息が果物のような匂いがする
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 叔母の血糖値が高すぎて機械がHIと表示し、吐いてお腹が痛く、ぼんやりしてきた
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 父の血圧が220/130で、ひどい頭痛と目のかすみがある
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 手術後ずっと寝ていたら、急に息が荒くなって血を咳き込んだ
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 片方のふくらはぎが腫れて熱を持ち、赤くてすごく痛い
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 急に右目が見えなくなった、黒いカーテンが下りてきたみたい
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 急に両目が見えなくなって、目がすごく痛く吐き気がする
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 光がチカチカした後に黒い点がたくさん飛んで、視界の半分がぼやける
misses.label: emergency
